verdict.rationale: Linear's changelog says any filtered view can be shared by copying its URL or pressing ⌘/Ctrl Shift C, which delivers the share-by-link part directly. A separate changelog entry about subscribing to events in project views shows that views exist as persistent objects, so saving is implied but not explicitly described. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of saving or naming a filtered view as a persistent custom view, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the sharing workflow.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can save a filtered view of work and share it with a link

citations.quote: You can now share any filtered view by copying its URL from your browser, or by pressing ⌘/Ctrl Shift C on desktop.
Added ability to subscribe to events in project views and receive notifications in Inbox or Slack
